sentences.en: First, we must acknowledge the errors made by our predecessors.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们必须承认前辈们犯下的错误。

sentences.en: We like the present headmaster better than his predecessor.
sentences.zh: 比起前任校长，我们更喜欢现在的校长。

sentences.en: This candidate is significantly better compared to his predecessor.
sentences.zh: 这位候选人比他的前任要好得多。
